directional_mark.focal_mechanism_representation: double-couple tensor from preferred nodal-plane-1 strike/dip/rake
directional_mark.local_frame: path-oriented local fault tangent + vertical + horizontal normal
directional_mark.response: wrapped child-minus-parent residual axial angle in [-pi/2,pi/2)

static_field_control.rule: subtract fault-segment axial circular mean estimated from TRAIN only

helical.name: DYNAMIC_HELICAL_EXTENSION
helical.helical_parameter: radians of axial rotation per network km

fit.beta_fit: TRAIN only by deterministic scipy L-BFGS-B minimizing parent-weighted axial circular loss with L2=1e-6
fit.concentration_kappa: estimated from TRAIN resultant residual after beta fit
fit.calibration_use: diagnostic only; no model-family or threshold changes
fit.test: single sealed chronological TEST per cohort

test_scoring.logscore: per-child log of parent-weighted axial von-Mises mixture
test_scoring.rmse: per-child parent-weighted circular-mean axial prediction error
test_scoring.bootstrap_unit: child event in moving time blocks

sequential_stop: if a cohort fails any primary effect-size/BIC gate, it is not positive and expensive nulls are not required to reject confirmation
terminal_rule: if both new-data cohorts fail confirmation, close seismic helical program with upper bounds
classification: BLIND_ANALYSIS_LOCK_BEFORE_ARTIFACT_ACCESS; graph topology itself was frozen before directional access
